text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the spring Tenno Sho is here.
Have we
found a way to compete
against Tamamo Cross's
purpose of
racing for her less-than-fortunate
family?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well? Did ya find a reason to race that's
better
than mine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thought so. Not that easy to find your
own
reason, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Happy, satisfied folks should just sit
quietly and
enjoy their lives.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Creek, today's crown is mine for the
takin'! I'm the
star!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I'll whomp that trainer lurkin'
behind ya so
bad they'll never be the
same.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Wh-what's gotten into ya all of a
sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I can't let you do that,
Tamtam.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's the one thing you won't ever get
away with!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The hell? I've never seen you like this
before...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, no point tryin' to threaten me
though.
Sheer will's not gonna win you
the race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Cause I ain't gonna hold back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's a terrifyingly serious look on
Super
Creek's face.
